children: Budur Kumar, an officer serving as Chief Medical Officer, reported sales of Harmony Biosciences common stock under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The reported transactions show weighted-average selling prices of $41.9839, $42.2475, $42.7947 and $43.1014 per share across the sales. The total sale proceeds reported were $1,453,169. Following the reported transactions, the reporter directly owns 13,115 shares of common stock. The reporting person stated they will provide full information on individual trade prices within the disclosed ranges upon request.
